description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewahamanduwa, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820010
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Wewahamanduwa, Matara. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, owner information, and encumbrances, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
